description: This file defines the 'Country' controller class in the Opencart Admin namespace, handling event-driven actions related to country data such as adding, editing, and deleting countries. It adds corresponding tasks to a task management system in response to these events.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class managing country-related event tasks in the admin panel of Opencart.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Handles post-addition event for a country by scheduling tasks to update country lists and info pages.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Handles post-edit event for a country by scheduling tasks to update country lists and specific country info.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Handles post-deletion event for a country by scheduling tasks to update country lists and remove specific country data.
